comingLast.roast: 23 points - the escape window is closing, the blue balls settling
finished 1 above the blue line - toasting every point Cornish does not score
finished 1 above Cornish - close enough to keep his speech drafted
finished 2 clear of the blue balls - now buying Cornish drinks out of gratitude
2 clear and finished - now a full-time Cornish supporter
his round is over, his sweating is not - 2 above the line
finished with a 3-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
finished 3 clear - the presentation can come whenever it likes now
in with a 3-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
